records.description_rewritten: An underground public toilet near Belgrade's National Theatre at Republic Square. The directory names a nearby WC sign and mentions an old approximate entry charge, but a 2026 independent site visit and the city public-toilet listing describe the National Theatre WC as publicly accessible and free. Exact entry and current payment should follow the operator, not directory copy.
records.location_identity: Public toilet adjacent to National Theatre, Trg republike 1, Stari Grad, Belgrade.
records.access_conditions: Municipal opening schedule winter 07:00–22:30 and summer 07:00–23:00, generally free; directory's old 'about 40 RSD' and 'all day' labels conflict. 2026 on-site sanitation article did not describe cruising.

independent_and_secondary_sources.finding: Primary detail describes underground WC, 6 comments age restricted; no dated content reliably readable.
Updated Belgrade sanitary guide lists National Theatre WC, free and seasonal public hours.
2026-07 report describes staffed, maintained WC at Republic Square; no cruising confirmation.

dated_reports.finding: Journalist visited National Theatre public toilet and described cleanliness, not cruising activity.
